TESTS: `alembic upgrade head` -> ran with no error (I only looked at the last lines of output). `pytest tests/integration/test_mindmap_workflows_e2e.py -q` -> `6 passed in 3.75s`. `ruff check tests/integration/test_mindmap_workflows_e2e.py` -> `All checks passed!`. `mypy tests/integration/test_mindmap_workflows_e2e.py` -> `Success: no issues found in 1 source file`.
NOTES:
- `SignoffRequiredError` is never raised by any domain code (only mapped in `map_work_item_error`). So `signoff_required` is covered only by a unit-style test of the mapping, not by calling `mindmap_workflow_propose_move`.
- `mindmap_work_list` loads items under the caller's own tenant, so only the owner sees them. The `role_restricted` blocked reason is checked by calling `compute_item_moves` directly for a viewer (tenant_c).
- The test DB first failed with "relation workflow_signoffs does not exist", so I ran `alembic upgrade head` before the final runs.
- `mindmap_set_status` rejects names outside the legacy statuses, so the test workflow uses stages `todo`, `in_progress` and `done`.
- Asserted a proposed move to an unknown stage returns `transition_not_found`, and a remap to an unknown stage returns `stage_not_found`; `stage_not_found` does occur in the remap case.
